summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing the upcoming opening of a new Canna Cabana retail cannabis store in Ottawa, Ontario. The store at 4828 Bank Street is expected to begin selling recreational cannabis on July 24, 2026, bringing the total store count to 229 locations across Canada. The filing contains no transactional event, no security issuance, no tender offer, no restructuring, and no management change. It is purely an operational update on retail expansion, not a special situation. The filing is a routine current report, not a special situation.
